def f2(g):
    from collections import Counter
    h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    cells=[(i,j,v) for i,r in enumerate(g) for j,v in enumerate(r) if v!=0]
    c=Counter(v for _,_,v in cells)
    inner=min(c,key=c.get)
    i0=min(i for i,j,_ in cells); i1=max(i for i,j,_ in cells)
    j0=min(j for i,j,_ in cells); j1=max(j for i,j,_ in cells)
    ic=[(i,j) for i,j,v in cells if v==inner]
    inh=max(i for i,j in ic)-min(i for i,j in ic)+1
    inw=max(j for i,j in ic)-min(j for i,j in ic)+1
    t=inh if inh==inw else max(1,min(inh,inw)-1)
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for i in range(max(0,i0-t),min(h,i1+t+1)):
        for j in range(max(0,j0-t),min(w,j1+t+1)):
            if g[i][j]==0: out[i][j]=inner
    return out
